Imagine—one moment, everything is quiet. Then suddenly, the ground shakes, and your whole world changes in a heartbeat. What happens to us when we’re buried by disaster, when fear and hope collide in the darkest of places?
Welcome to a journey where the boundaries between despair and resilience are pushed to their very limits. Together, we’ll step into the story of Viral Dalal, as shared in his powerful memoir, Choosing Light: When an Earthquake Buried Me and My Family for 5 Days, I Learned to Fully Live.
Picture this: entombed beneath rubble, the silence feels endless. Every breath is a fight, every memory and regret comes rushing in, and yet—there’s a flicker of hope that rescue might still be possible. Can you imagine what it takes to hold on, hour after hour, day after day?
As we explore Viral’s incredible ordeal, we’ll see just how life, family, and faith are transformed when everything else falls away. What truly matters reveals itself in the most unexpected ways.
This isn’t just a story about surviving—it’s about choosing hope, gratitude, and light, even when darkness feels overwhelming. Viral’s journey invites us to look at our own lives and ask: what would I hold onto when everything else is gone?
Together, let’s discover how the human spirit finds strength, connection, and renewal, even in the face of unimaginable loss. This path from devastation to awakening is more than an inspiring tale—it’s a reminder that, no matter how deep the darkness, there’s always a way to choose light.
